description.value: Free on-demand cable ferry operated by WaterBridge Ferries Inc. under contract to the BC Ministry of Transportation and Transit, crossing the junction of Upper and Lower Arrow Lakes on Highway 6, about 22 km south of Nakusp. Crossing takes about 5 minutes; runs on demand 5 am–12:05 pm and 2:15–9:20 pm daily (closed for a midday break), no reservation needed. BC's Ministry of Transportation and Transit treats all inland ferries as an extension of the provincial highway system, mandated to accommodate all legal road users, including cyclists — bikes and e-bikes both ride free and unboxed.
